messages:
deploy-bot: Automated canary bump started for model rl-inference/embedder-v2 (rollout id rl_20260323_01) -> target 15% in eu-west. metrics: https://internal.metrics/rl_20260323_01 Observed: p99 latency +120ms vs baseline, error rate +1.8% (auto-hold threshold = 1.5%).

maria: seeing the p99 jump, looking at traces now.

kevin: quick context: this is the V2.3.1 embedder rollout referenced in release notes https://go/redwood/releases/v2.3.1 — change window 02:00-06:00 UTC.

maria: p50 looks fine, errors concentrated on short-input workloads (search snippets). many 5xx tokenizer errors in the trace samples.

samir: pulling infra metrics — KV cache evictions spike coincident with canary start. attaching first logs in a sec.

ops-jen: oncall here. given auto-hold hit, recommend immediate hold + quickvote for rollback. we should pin to last known good (rl_20260320_01).

kevin: what's the risk to users if we let it run? change window still open but product flagged this as risky.

pete: product prefers rollback; this affects search relevance for paying customers. we should stop.

maria: to pin traffic back, run: 
```
/deploy pin rl_20260323_01 target=0% fallback=rl_20260320_01 reason="canary p99+ errors"
```

kevin: I vote STOP (:+1: stop).

samir: STOP from infra side as well, will collect heapdumps and KV profiles.

ops-jen: STOP — initiating rollback/pin.

aiqa-bot: quality-eval: prompt-set "search-short" drift -2.3% after rollout start. automated alert created.

deploy-bot: Action: executing pin command and scaling rl_20260323_01 -> 0% over 30s. Will post updates.

maria: monitoring the traffic shift. please hold new deploy PRs until we confirm.

kevin: I'll update release notes and buyer-facing comms after we confirm.

pete: thanks — please mention that we paused the canary and rolled back to last-stable.

samir: infra note: KV cache eviction rate climbed 4x, correlates with heavier concurrent tokenization calls. saving diagnostics: /artifacts/rl_20260323_01/kv-profiles.tar.gz
deploy-bot: Traffic scale-down complete: rl_20260323_01 -> 0%. Status: rolled back (pinned to rl_20260320_01). Incident tag: INC-20260323-47.

maria: confirmed traffic 0% and baseline restored. created rollback marker rl_rollback_1777771234.

ops-jen: assigning postmortem to @maria @samir @kevin. Please add timeline and initial hypotheses. I'll create the incident in pager duty.

aiqa-bot: scheduled re-eval of v2.3.1 in 2h after initial cleanroom tests.

kevin: I'll mirror this thread into #incidents and update the release notes with rollback details + next steps for a hotfix.

pete: appreciate the quick responses. once root cause confirmed we can coordinate a re-roll with mitigations. :green_heart:

samir: collecting heapdumps and will upload; link when ready.

maria: keeping this thread for release audit; will add postmortem draft by EOD.

deploy-bot: Summary: canary auto-hold triggered -> team confirmed STOP -> pin back to rl_20260320_01 -> traffic 0% -> incident created.

kevin: closing action items: postmortem, release note update, infra mitigation plan.

maria: end of thread.
